title: Acquire a local response table from one retained noisy trajectory
statement: First-visit quotas and nondemolition majority sensing give a return-and-invalid-table bound alpha=L exp[-2r(1/2-e_s)^2]+2M exp(-2m w^2). Simultaneous intervals permit data-dependent selection of a local contraction mode.

requires: supplied local causal parent graph and stationary response law
holdable native bits and bounded conditional sensor error
provides: conditional-on-contract acquired contraction certificate when q<1
assumptions: fresh update response selected before its noise
no unmodeled hidden influence bypassing parent bits
costs: all failed/excess visits, raw reads, holds and update pulses
table size exponential in local parent count
contract.units: probability intervals, confidence, read counts and physical latency
contract.obstruction: No initialized context oracle is supplied; return-and-error is not conditional-on-return confidence or guaranteed runtime.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
